'use strict';
__ORIGIN__
// __NAME_TEXT__ (__BASE_TEXT__). Generated by tools/source-lab.js (generate) from the Iken template of the project: the site is a
// Next.js reader that gets its data from a JSON API (/api/query, /api/post, /api/chapters, /api/chapter), which this source asks
// directly. Nothing was copied from another app. What the generator measured on the site is in the header of the generated report.

const { fetchText } = require('../../server/modules/network/fetch-utils');
const { normalizeStatus } = require('../../server/modules/common/manga-status');
const { proxyImageUrl: proxyImg } = require('../../server/modules/common/image-proxy');

const BASE = __BASE__;
const API = __API__; // where the site's JSON API is (an api. host, or the site itself)
const SITE = __NAME__;
const GENRE_IDS = __GENRE_IDS__; // lower-case genre name -> the numeric id the API's genreIds filter takes
const PER_PAGE = 24;
// Categories that are never listed. Matched at the start of each word, so a rename or a multi-word name is caught too.
const NEVER_LISTED_RE = /(^|[^a-z])(loli|shota|toddler)/i;
const MANGA_ID_RE = /^[\w-]+$/;
const CHAPTER_ID_RE = /^[\w-]+\/\d{1,12}$/;
// The order words the app sends, and what the API takes for each: [orderBy, orderDirection].
const ORDER = { relevance: ['lastChapterAddedAt', 'desc'], latestUploadedChapter: ['lastChapterAddedAt', 'desc'], views: ['totalViews', 'desc'], title: ['postTitle', 'asc'], '-title': ['postTitle', 'desc'] };

function httpError(message, statusCode) {
  const e = new Error(message);
  e.statusCode = statusCode;
  return e;
}

function empty() {
  return { results: [], hasNextPage: false };
}

// The API is meant for the site's own page, which a browser makes look like: the site as the origin and the referrer, JSON as the answer.
const API_HEADERS = { Accept: 'application/json, text/plain, */*', Origin: BASE, Referer: `${BASE}/` };

// One request where 404 is a normal answer: no retries (guide, section 3).
async function getJson(path) {
  let text;
  try {
    text = await fetchText(`${API}${path}`, 0, { extraHeaders: API_HEADERS });
  } catch (err) {
    if (/^HTTP 404$/.test(err.message)) throw httpError('not found', 404);
    throw new Error(`${SITE}: ${err.message}`, { cause: err });
  }
  let data;
  try {
    data = JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (err) {
    if (/<title>\s*Just a moment/i.test(text)) throw new Error('the site asked for an anti-bot check (known limit)');
    throw new Error(`${SITE}: the API did not answer with JSON`, { cause: err });
  }
  return data;
}

function absUrl(u = '') {
  const s = String(u).trim();
  if (!s || /^data:/i.test(s)) return '';
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(s)) return s;
  if (s.startsWith('//')) return `https:${s}`;
  return BASE + (s.startsWith('/') ? s : `/${s}`);
}

function plainText(html) {
  const once = String(html || '').replace(/<(script|style)[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi, ' ').replace(/<br\s*\/?>|<\/p>|<\/div>/gi, '\n').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ');
  const decoded = once.replace(/&nbsp;/g, ' ').replace(/&amp;/g, '&').replace(/&lt;/g, '<').replace(/&gt;/g, '>').replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/&#0?39;/g, "'");
  return decoded.replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ').replace(/\n\s*\n+/g, '\n\n').trim();
}

const isNovel = (post) => post && (post.isNovel === true || /novel/i.test(String(post.seriesType || '')));
const genreNames = (post) => (Array.isArray(post && post.genres) ? post.genres.map((g) => String((g && g.name) || '').trim()).filter(Boolean) : []);
const never = (post) => genreNames(post).some((g) => NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(g));

function card(post) {
  const id = String(post.slug || '');
  const cover = absUrl(post.featuredImage);
  return {
    id,
    title: String(post.postTitle || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() || id,
    cover: cover ? proxyImg(cover) : '',
    url: `${BASE}/series/${id}`,
    genres: genreNames(post),
    status: normalizeStatus(post.seriesStatus),
    author: '',
  };
}

// ---- lists and search ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function query({ page = 1, text = '', order = 'relevance', genreIds = [] }) {
  const p = Math.max(1, Number(page) || 1);
  const [orderBy, direction] = ORDER[order] || ORDER.relevance;
  const q = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(p), perPage: String(PER_PAGE), searchTerm: text, orderBy, orderDirection: direction, seriesStatus: '', seriesType: '', genreIds: genreIds.join(',') });
  const data = await getJson(`/api/query?${q}`);
  const posts = Array.isArray(data && data.posts) ? data.posts : null;
  if (!posts) throw new Error(`${SITE}: the list has an unexpected shape`);
  const results = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const post of posts) {
    const id = String((post && post.slug) || '');
    if (!id || seen.has(id) || !MANGA_ID_RE.test(id) || isNovel(post) || never(post)) continue;
    seen.add(id);
    results.push(card(post));
  }
  return { results, hasNextPage: Number(data.totalCount) > p * PER_PAGE };
}

module.exports = {
  meta: {
    id: __ID__, name: __NAME__, version: '1.0.0', author: 'generated',
    supportsPopularAllTime: true,
    supportsRecentlyAdded: false,
    ui: {
      filters: {
        orderBy: [
          { value: 'relevance', label: 'Latest Updated' },
          { value: 'views', label: 'Most Viewed' },
          { value: 'title', label: 'Name A-Z' },
        ],
        publicationStatus: false,
        contentRating: false,
        format: false,
        genres: true,
      },
      genres: __GENRES__,
      nsfwGenres: __NSFW__,
      nativeDates: true,
      adultOnly: __ADULT_ONLY__, // every title of the site is adult: Hide NSFW hides the whole source
    },
  },

  // Text search, or the site's own list (sorted when the app asks).
  async search(query_, page = 1, orderBy = '') {
    const q = String(query_ || '').trim();
    if (q && NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(q)) return empty();
    return query({ page, text: q, order: orderBy });
  },

  // The API takes several genre ids at once: a name the site does not have (or a never-listed one) is nothing.
  async byGenres(genres, orderBy = '', _filters = {}, page = 1) {
    const names = (Array.isArray(genres) ? genres : [genres]).map((g) => String(g || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!names.length || names.some((g) => NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(g))) return empty();
    const ids = names.map((g) => GENRE_IDS[g.toLowerCase()]);
    if (ids.some((id) => !Number.isInteger(id))) return empty();
    const list = await query({ page, order: orderBy, genreIds: ids });
    return { results: list.results.map((c) => ({ ...c, genres: c.genres.length ? c.genres : names })), hasNextPage: list.hasNextPage };
  },

  async trending() {
    return { results: (await query({ order: 'views' })).results };
  },

  async latestUpdates() {
    return { results: (await query({ order: 'relevance' })).results };
  },

  async popularAllTime() {
    return { results: (await query({ order: 'views' })).results };
  },

  async mangaDetails(mangaId) {
    const id = String(mangaId || '');
    if (!MANGA_ID_RE.test(id)) throw httpError('invalid title id', 400);
    const data = await getJson(`/api/post?postSlug=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
    const post = data && data.post;
    if (!post || !post.postTitle || isNovel(post) || never(post)) throw httpError(`"${id}" not found`, 404); // an answer that is not a title
    return {
      id,
      title: String(post.postTitle).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
      cover: proxyImg(absUrl(post.featuredImage)),
      description: plainText(post.postContent),
      status: normalizeStatus(post.seriesStatus),
      genres: genreNames(post),
      author: [post.author, post.artist].map((v) => String(v || '').trim()).filter((v, i, all) => v && all.indexOf(v) === i).join(', '),
      url: `${BASE}/series/${id}`,
    };
  },

  async chapters(mangaId) {
    const id = String(mangaId || '');
    if (!MANGA_ID_RE.test(id)) throw httpError('invalid title id', 400);
    // The list is its own call (the title's answer carries only the count): the title first, for its numeric id.
    const head = await getJson(`/api/post?postSlug=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
    const post = head && head.post;
    if (!post || !Number.isInteger(post.id) || isNovel(post) || never(post)) throw httpError(`"${id}" not found`, 404);
    const data = await getJson(`/api/chapters?postId=${post.id}`);
    const rows = Array.isArray(data && data.post && data.post.chapters) ? data.post.chapters : [];
    const now = Date.now();
    const chapters = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const c of rows) {
      // A chapter the site keeps back (paid, scheduled, behind a short link) is not a missing chapter and is not offered.
      if (!c || !Number.isInteger(c.id) || c.isLocked || c.isTimeLocked || c.isPermanentlyLocked || c.isShortLinkLocked || (c.price && !c.chapterPurchased)) continue;
      if (seen.has(c.id)) continue;
      seen.add(c.id);
      const num = String(c.number === undefined || c.number === null ? '' : c.number).trim();
      const title = String(c.title || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      const name = `Chapter ${num}${title && title !== num ? ` - ${title}` : ''}`.trim();
      const t = Date.parse(c.createdAt);
      chapters.push({
        id: `${id}/${c.id}`,
        name,
        title: name,
        chapter: /^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(num) ? num : '',
        url: `${BASE}/series/${id}/${String(c.slug || '').replace(/[^\w-]/g, '')}`,
        publishAt: Number.isFinite(t) && t <= now + 2 * 86400000 ? new Date(t).toISOString() : null,
        pages: [],
      });
    }
    if (!chapters.length) throw new Error(`${SITE}: no readable chapter found`);
    // Newest first, as the app expects: by number when every chapter has one, else as the site sent them.
    if (chapters.every((c) => c.chapter)) chapters.sort((a, b) => Number(b.chapter) - Number(a.chapter));
    return { chapters };
  },

  async pages(chapterId) {
    const id = String(chapterId || '');
    if (!CHAPTER_ID_RE.test(id)) throw httpError('invalid chapter id', 400); // also refuses ../../etc/passwd
    const data = await getJson(`/api/chapter?chapterId=${id.split('/')[1]}`);
    const chapter = data && data.chapter;
    if (!chapter) throw httpError(`chapter "${id}" not found`, 404);
    if (chapter.isLocked || chapter.isLockedByCoins || chapter.isPermanentlyLocked || chapter.isShortLinkLocked) throw httpError(`chapter "${id}" is locked on the site`, 403);
    const images = (Array.isArray(chapter.images) ? chapter.images : []).filter((im) => im && typeof im.url === 'string' && im.url.trim());
    // In the order the site gives them (a number each), the rest as sent.
    images.sort((a, b) => (Number.isFinite(Number(a.order)) ? Number(a.order) : 1e9) - (Number.isFinite(Number(b.order)) ? Number(b.order) : 1e9));
    const pages = [];
    for (const im of images) {
      const src = absUrl(im.url.trim().replace(/ /g, '%20'));
      if (src) pages.push({ index: pages.length, img: proxyImg(src) });
    }
    if (!pages.length) throw httpError(`chapter "${id}" not found`, 404); // an answer with no pictures
    return { pages };
  },
};
